faq.question: Can Indian students study Computer Science Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply directly to English-taught Bachelor

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for Computer Science Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees for international students range from approximately €10,000 to €12,000 (around ₹10.86 lakh to ₹13.03 lakh). Many universities offer early-bird fee discounts and merit scholarships.

faq.question: Is IELTS mandatory for admission to Finnish computer science programmes?
faq.answer: While IELTS (minimum 6.0–6.5) is widely accepted, universities also accept TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, or SAT scores depending on their specific admissions pathway.

faq.question: How can Edu-Hawk Worldwide help with admission?
faq.answer: Edu-Hawk Worldwide provides comprehensive support including university shortlisting, eligibility evaluation, document verification, SOP reviews, Studyinfo.fi portal application, and Finnish residence permit guidance.
